source: Made by ffmpeg 8.1.3 on 13-10-2026: a 440 Hz tone and pink noise, 48 kHz stereo, -c:a libopus -b:a 128k -vbr off -frame_duration 10 -application lowdelay (10 ms frames of one size, as a console sends them); pcm is that ffmpeg's own Opus decoder's output (16 bits, interleaved), which skips the encoder's first pre_skip samples.
